claims.label: General oxide method
claims.statement: Section 2.2 reports spin coating at 5000 rpm followed by ambient annealing at 550 degrees C for 30 min.

claims.label: ZnO device method
claims.statement: The device method uses ZnO sol at 3000 rpm for 1 min, an intermediate 300 degrees C treatment for 15 min, and final annealing at 550 degrees C for 30 min.

conflictPairs.context: These are separately scoped methods. The ZnO device settings are not substituted into the general ZnO/IZO method.

claims.label: Growth and surface discussion
claims.statement: The authors describe the synthesized nanocrystals as bare and cite FTIR evidence.
claims.sourceLocator: Main PDF p.4, Section 3.5, FTIR discussion

claims.label: Actual device fabrication
claims.statement: Device coating alternates PbS dispersion with 1 vol% EDT in acetonitrile at 2500 rpm; the process is repeated three times.

conflictPairs.context: Bare growth is not a claim that the fabricated devices were never treated with EDT.

scopeLabel: All ten main and eleven SI pages read by the author and independent auditor; scoped independent audit completed. Growth intermediates, physical specimens, device variants and source contradictions remain distinct.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
